limitations: Training is explicitly adapted to Modern 4e proficiency (+5 in the baseline engine). Choice uses the current 16 skills, including new Crafting (Intelligence), Medicine (Intelligence), Society (Intelligence), Nature and Wisdom-based Religion.
Dungeoneering is folded into Nature; History and Streetwise into Society; Heal into Medicine. No vanilla skill math is supplied.
Repeat selection and distinct chosen-skill constraints are not expressible in v1 mechanics.

presentation.description:
Skill Training

Benefit: You gain training in one skill, which doesn't need to be on your class skills list.
Special: You can take this feat more than once. Each time you select this feat, choose a different skill.

Power Attack

Heroic Tier
Prerequisite: Str 15
Benefit: When making a melee attack, you can take a -2 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll (or a +3 bonus to the damage roll with a two-handed weapon).
    This extra damage increases by level, as shown on the table below, but the attack penalty remains the same.

LevelExtra Damage (Two-Handed Weapon)
1st–10th+2 (+3)
11th–20th+4 (+6)
21th–30th+6 (+9)
